processes.name: 5D process
processes.fit: Best for new products with open questions

steps.name: Discover
steps.desc: Goals, users and competitors. You get a one-page brief.

steps.name: Define
steps.desc: Flows, scope and priorities. You get a user-flow map.

steps.name: Design
steps.desc: Wireframes to polished UI. You get a clickable prototype.

steps.name: Develop
steps.desc: Built in code, or handed to your developers.

steps.name: Deliver
steps.desc: Launch, testing and handover. You get the files and a walkthrough.

processes.name: Sprint-based
processes.fit: Best for teams who want to see progress every week

steps.name: Kickoff
steps.desc: Agree the goal, the backlog and the first sprint.

steps.name: Sprint 1–2 weeks
steps.desc: Design a slice of the product, end to end.

steps.name: Review
steps.desc: Demo, feedback, and plan the next sprint.

steps.name: Handover
steps.desc: Final files, design system and build support.

processes.name: Design, then handoff
processes.fit: Best when you already have developers

steps.name: UX
steps.desc: Flows and wireframes you can test early.

steps.name: Design system
steps.desc: Tokens and components your developers reuse.

steps.name: Developer handoff
